prologue_01.situation: You wake at the edge of an unfamiliar village. A lively square lies one way, a quiet lakeside path the other.

picks.a: Head to the square and take in the scene
picks.b: Walk by the lake and collect your thoughts

picks.a: Follow the familiar old stone wall
picks.b: Take the new path past the pinwheels
